card.name: Section breaks in drug label text
card.fires_on: Responds to a spot just before a new item or heading in label text, such as a space before a section number, a period ending a sentence, or a word inside a list of adverse reactions. Fires on the marked piece itself, not on a single fixed word.

modes.label: Gap before section number
modes.description: A space or sentence end right before a numbered label heading like 5.15 or 7.6.

modes.label: Inside adverse reaction terms
modes.description: A word piece within a heading or list of reactions, such as verse in Adverse or negative in a symptom list.

modes.label: Table symbols and numbers
modes.description: A symbol or space inside a table or numeric result, such as an arrow or the gap before 50.
